title: Test pyramid policy (test-pyramid.yaml)
description: Which test levels (unit/integration/api/e2e) a kind of task requires, by default, before qa-engineer or test-planner decides the same thing again from scratch every time (T21). This is a floor, not a plan: test-planner still writes the specific case per REQ-NNN, but the level(s) it picks for a task of this type may never be a strict subset of what's declared required here without saying why in test-plan.md's Unresolved Open Questions.

version.description: Schema generation of this file. Bumped only when a change would break an existing reader.

task_types.description: Task type id -> its declaration. Ids are stable identifiers referenced from test-plan.md, so they are lower-case and unpunctuated.

description.description: What kind of task.md line this covers, in one sentence — specific enough that test-planner can tell which id applies without guessing.

required_levels.description: The test levels this task type never ships without, lowest first. Not exhaustive — test-planner may add more for a specific requirement — but never fewer without recording why.

why.description: Why this floor, specifically — the failure mode skipping it would let through. Optional but strongly expected: a floor with no reason is a rule nobody can evaluate an exception against.
